tracks.title: Andale
tracks.description: High-octane tempo paired with introspective undertones, exploring relentless momentum and the hunger to outrun inner ghosts.

lyrics.text: Late night in the steel city, wheels turning fast
Tell 'em Ándale, I cannot leave my future in the past

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: McKees Rocks is an old industrial steel hub. Growing up there, everyone told me to stay in line and take a mill or factory shift. 'Ándale' was my refusal to stand still. If you don't sprint toward what you want, this city will freeze you in place.

lyrics.text: They only love you when you're gone, but check the aftermath
Gave my brother my last dollar, put my city on my back

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: Family loyalty is non-negotiable for me. When money was tightest during early recording sessions, whatever cash we had went into studio equipment and keeping my circle fed.

lyrics.text: Run it up, no brake lines, living on the edge
Used to scream into the microphone with blood upon the ledge

tracks.title: Overthink
tracks.description: A vulnerable confession on paralysis by analysis, insomniac spirals, and fighting the self-destructive loops in your own head.

lyrics.text: 3 AM ceiling staring, clock is ticking loud
I build a fortress in my head and let it burn back down

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: I produce and write in isolation late at night. Sometimes the obsession with making every syllable perfect turns into self-sabotage. You build up all these plans, then tear them down before dawn out of insecurity.

lyrics.text: Is it paranoia or just seeing through the crowd?

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: Transitioning from Ty Sciullo into Unnoticed came from realizing how many people around you are just spectators waiting to see you stumble. Becoming 'unseen' allowed me to observe who was real.

lyrics.text: Every conversation replayed twenty times or more
Leave the key beneath the mat but keep a lock upon the door

tracks.title: This Ain't Love
tracks.description: Atmospheric bass and haunting reverb dissecting toxic attachments, emotional debt, and clarity in the aftermath of heartbreak.

lyrics.text: You only call me when the liquor starts to speak for you
We call it passion but it's poison wrapped in deja vu

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: We often mistake chaos for intensity. When you grow up in turbulence, peace feels foreign, so you keep running back into emotional fires because at least they feel warm.

lyrics.text: Look in the mirror and I wonder who I'm turning to
This ain't love, this is surviving what we couldn't lose

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: This line anchors the whole song. It wasn't about love anymore; it was an ego game of who refused to be the first one to walk away.

tracks.title: Baddie
tracks.description: Seductive 808s and crisp snare rolls exploring nocturnal city nightlife, allure, and unsaid tensions.

lyrics.text: Black tint on the windows when we pull up to the venue
She got expensive taste, ain't looking at no menu

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: A lighter, infectious bounce that came together during our weekend sessions in Philly. We wanted an energetic vibe that would hit in the club while keeping that moody undertone.

lyrics.text: Eyes locked from across the room, she knowing what we came to do

tracks.title: SMILE
tracks.description: An ironic, emotionally charged anthem about wearing a counterfeit grin to protect the people around you from your reality.

lyrics.text: Put on the costume, step under neon lights
Tell everybody you're okay to get through one more night

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: The mask of entertaining. As an artist, everyone expects you to be 'on' all the time. 'SMILE' is the reality of smiling through anxiety and depression so you don't bring down the room.

lyrics.text: Flash from the cameras blind the tears inside your eyes

tracks.title: Calling for Help
tracks.description: A chilling acoustic guitar riff swallowed by thunderous sub-bass, chronicling an SOS to the universe when you've hit rock bottom.

lyrics.text: Dialing numbers in the dark, nobody on the line
Praying for a signal just to know that I'm alive

annotation.author: UNNOTICED
annotation.content: I wrote this at the lowest point of 2023. When you're suffering in silence, reaching out feels like admitting defeat. I put it on wax because I know thousands of people listening are feeling that exact same silence.

lyrics.text: If you hear me through the static, hold the line

biography.title: The Industrial Roots of McKees Rocks
biography.text: Born on August 29, 1997 in McKees Rocks, Pennsylvania—a gritty, storied borough nestled along the Ohio River adjacent to Pittsburgh—Tyler R. Sciullo grew up surrounded by the unvarnished realities of the American Rust Belt. In an environment defined by relentless work shifts, shuttered factories, and generational grind, music was not merely a hobby; it was an existential lifeline. Witnessing family members trapped in unfulfilling jobs catalyzed Tyler's fierce determination to craft his own destiny on his own terms.

biography.title: The Ty Sciullo Era & The Rise (2016–2022)
biography.text: At 19, Tyler began carving out his presence under the moniker Ty Sciullo. With early breakthrough records like 'Cold Night' and the Tunnabeatz-produced underground anthem 'Insanity,' his music struck a chord with listeners who felt isolated. Over the subsequent six years, Tyler released a steady cadence of emotive singles, coordinated regional tour dates across the East Coast, and amassed hundreds of thousands of organic streams. His signature style fused introspective vulnerability with sharp lyrical wit, speaking frankly about depression, grief, and survival.

biography.title: Metamorphosis: Now A Man Unseen (UNNOTICED)
biography.text: Artistic evolution demands shedding old skin. In 2024, Tyler stepped away from the spotlight to undergo a fundamental creative transformation, adopting the artist identity UNNOTICED. 'Once known as Ty Sciullo, now a man unseen' became the mantra of this new era. Stripping away superficial industry vanity, UNNOTICED focuses purely on visceral sonic storytelling—layering nocturnal synths, haunting vocal textures, and unapologetic confessions across breakout tracks like 'Andale', 'Overthink', and 'This Ain't Love'. He remains the voice of those who feel overlooked, giving power to the invisible.

epkData.headline: UNNOTICED — Official Electronic Press Kit (EPK)
epkData.shortBio: UNNOTICED (Tyler R. Sciullo) is a Pittsburgh-born recording artist crafting nocturnal alternative hip-hop and emotionally resonant dark pop. Emerging from McKees Rocks, PA, he fuses raw introspection with anthemic production, surpassing millions of global streams while giving a voice to the overlooked.

pressQuotes.quote: UNNOTICED strips away the polished veneer of modern pop-rap to deliver visceral, skin-tingling vulnerability that sticks in your ribs.
Ty Sciullo's evolution into UNNOTICED represents one of the most compelling artistic rebirths to emerge from the Pittsburgh metropolitan scene.
Melodies that haunt your midnight hours and lyricism sharp enough to cut through industry noise.
